name: @projexlight/sdk-diagnostic-telemetry
summary: Crash + diagnostic telemetry for ProjexCloud: structured crash reports, per-tenant health snapshots, optional session-replay events. Sits next to sdk-trace (which handles request-level tracing) — this SDK is for product-level health: 'is the mobile app crashing for tenant X', 'what's the device-fleet OS version distribution', 'what UI step did the user reach before abandoning'.

endpoints.description: Submit a crash report (mobile / browser / server).
Fetch one crash report + stack + related session-replay frames.
List crashes for a tenant + filters.
Health snapshot per tenant: app version distribution, crash rate, replay sample rate.

events.name: diagnostic.crash.deduped.v1
events.description: Identical crash matched an existing group; counter incremented.

events.name: diagnostic.health.snapshot.v1
events.description: Per-tenant snapshot: crash rate, fleet versions, anomalies.

models.description: Per-crash row: app_version, stack_hash, persona_id, occurred_at, group_id.
Per-snapshot row: tenant_id, period, fleet_versions_json, crash_rate.
Per-frame row: persona_id, ui_state_json, occurred_at, redaction_applied.

hooks.name: reportCrash
hooks.description: Service entry — accept a crash report; dedup by stack hash; group with prior occurrences.

hooks.name: captureReplayFrame
hooks.description: Capture a session-replay frame (rate-limited + auto-redact known PII fields).

hooks.name: computeHealthSnapshot
hooks.description: Compute a per-tenant health snapshot for the period.

scenarios.title: Mobile app crashes → report submitted on next launch
scenarios.when_to_use: App crashed; on next launch the SDK uploads the structured crash. Dedup by stack hash groups same-bug occurrences.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Crash row + emits .crash.reported.v1. If matches existing group, .crash.deduped.v1 fires + counter increments.

scenarios.title: Hourly snapshot reveals a regression
scenarios.when_to_use: Snapshot shows crash-rate spike for app_version 3.2.1 on iOS; eng investigates + rolls back via sdk-feature-flags kill-switch.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Snapshot emitted. Anomaly detector pages on-call. Engineering ships hotfix or pulls flag.

scenarios.title: Customer reports broken flow → session replay shows the steps
scenarios.when_to_use: Support escalation; eng pulls the session-replay frames for the persona + sees exactly what UI states they hit.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Frames stored with PII auto-redacted. Eng review reveals the off-by-one form-validation bug.

scenarios.title: Bug spike — 10k identical crashes dedup to one group
scenarios.when_to_use: Mass crash on app release; dedup groups them so the dashboard doesn't show 10k rows + storage stays manageable.
scenarios.example_code:
// reportCrash internally hashes the normalized stack;
// matches existing group → increments counter + emits .crash.deduped.v1.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Dashboard shows 1 group with count=10000. Storage cost proportional to unique groups, not raw events.

scenarios.title: Session-replay frame redacts known PII fields
scenarios.when_to_use: Replay frame captures a form with SSN + email; the SDK redacts before upload — eng sees the flow, not the values.
scenarios.example_code:
// captureReplayFrame internally walks DIAGNOSTIC_PII_REDACTION_FIELDS
// + replaces matched values with '[REDACTED]'.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Upload contains UI structure + types + non-PII values. Eng can reproduce the bug without seeing customer PII.

compliance_posture.notes: Session-replay frames are PII-sensitive — auto-redaction enforced + frame retention bounded. Crash stacks scrubbed for embedded customer values before storage. Health snapshots are tenant-aggregated; no cross-tenant leakage.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per crash report (dedup hits billed lower)
